title: Right path of the coefficient tensor square on representatives
statement: For any good integral cochain representatives P,Q, pre composed with the right derived tensor/reduction/pullback path and then post is rightNormal, namely the derived image of the ordinary right cochain path, conjugated by the same representative maps as the left path.

proof.text: Use the realization model equation on each of P,Q, and bifunctoriality of system tensor, to rewrite the two input comparisons. Naturality of the reduction tensor comparison moves the pullback representative maps. Apply the defining ringed tensor pullback square and mu_model on U. Naturality of the reduction model on the ordinary ringed tensor map and of the system tensor model on the ordinary mates gives rightNormal. Paste these five equations using associativity.

from.place: Proved representative normalization, split into files to respect the per-file compile limit.

lean.statement:
theorem right_on_representatives
    (o : Operations l E) (m : RealizationModel l E o) (d : RingedModels l E)
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ V) (P Q : (good l E V).FullSubcategory) :
    pre l E o m d f P Q ≫
        (rightPath l E o m d f).app
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q.obj) ≫
        post l E o m d f P Q = rightNormal l E o m d f P Q
